description: The Building Permits Survey (BPS) of the U.S. Census Bureau provides national, state and local statistics on new privately owned residential construction authorised by building permits, under Title 13 of the United States Code with voluntary responses. Data are available monthly, year to date and annually for the nation, states, core based statistical areas, counties and permit-issuing places, with current tables from 2019 in Excel, historical state and metropolitan files from 1995 and detailed comma-delimited ASCII files. On 14 May 2026 the Bureau released final 2025 annual estimates by region, division, state, CBSA, county, permit-issuing place and island areas, added American Samoa for the first time and consolidated the annual history tables; revised monthly permits are usually released on the 17th workday of the month. Coverage: the United States and island areas. Access: free downloads. Licence: U.S. government statistics. Caveats: permits count authorised housing units, not completions, and cover only new private residential construction. Simulation uses are projecting housing stock growth by place for exposure and infrastructure demand scenarios. Related records: NYC DOB permit issuance and the ATTOM property data.
